objective: Convert calibrated diagnostic findings into a small, prioritized, preservation-safe revision-opportunity set before any revision generation.
rules: Only STEP-007 LIMITATION or OPPORTUNITY findings marked revision_eligible may support ADMIT.
Deduplicate findings that refer to the same opportunity_id before ranking.
Correlated specialists are evidence, not votes; repeated signals from one evidence family do not multiply confidence.
Any material disagreement or abstention attached to an otherwise eligible opportunity yields REVIEW_CONFLICT unless a hard preservation rejection already applies.
Explicit preservation conflicts veto admission regardless of expected impact.
Opportunity ranking is conditional on passage purpose, preservation/voice/collateral risk, and edit-budget fit.
Internal priority is not a prose-quality score and must not be exposed as universal literary quality.
When evidence is insufficient, conflicting, out of scope, or below minimum expected value, NO_ACTION or review is preferred to speculative revision.
At most three opportunities are admitted by default; overflow is rejected for bounded scope rather than silently promoted.
No revision text, manuscript mutation, author-intent resolution, or named-author target is permitted in STEP-008.

research_hardening.no_consensus: LLM judges tend to force a stance in ambiguous/no-consensus settings; explicit REVIEW_CONFLICT is therefore first-class.
research_hardening.judge_instability: LLM-as-judge ratings can be inconsistent across runs; repeated model judgments must not be treated as independent votes.
research_hardening.self_preference: Evaluator self-preference is a documented risk; admission does not accept generator identity as evidence of quality.
research_hardening.uncertainty_marker_bias: LLM judges can penalize epistemic uncertainty markers; uncertainty wording itself is not negative literary evidence.

promotion_boundary: STEP-008 produces opportunity admission only. It cannot declare a revision superior, mutate a manuscript, or promote any candidate.
